data.name: Awn
data.gender_notes: Awn is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘awna’ which means ‘to support’, ‘to help’, or ‘to assist’. The name Awn is a reflection of one’s character and values, symbolizing someone who is always there to lend a helping hand, and provide support and assistance when needed. The name Awn carries the meaning “Support, Help” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Awn usually hope their child will grow to embody support, help and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that inspires one to be a source of strength and support for others.
data.etymology: Awn belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Support, Help.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Awn total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

Muslims are encouraged to provide support and help one another, and the name Awn embodies this value of brotherhood and sisterhood. It is a reminder of the importance of compassion, kindness, and generosity towards others, and of our collective responsibility to uplift and care for one another.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Awn holds immense importance in Islamic tradition as it reflects the character of Allah, who is the ultimate supporter and helper. Muslims believe that Allah is always there to help and guide them, and the name Awn serves as a reminder of this divine mercy and compassion. Furthermore, the name Awn encourages individuals to embody the qualities of a good Muslim, by being a source of help and support for others and striving to serve and help those in need, as an act of worship and devotion to Allah.

historical_references.reference: Awn ibn al-A'war Thaqafi was a famous poet and companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). His poetry mostly revolved around love and longing for the Prophet. The name 'Awn means 'help' or 'support' in Arabic, reflecting his unwavering loyalty and support to the Prophet.

historical_references.reference: Awn al-Qarshi was a prominent Sufi mystic and poet from the 13th century in Iran. His poetry and teachings revolved around the theme of love and devotion to Allah. The name 'Awn is believed to signify 'help' or 'support' in the spiritual journey towards Allah.
